title: rclone with backblaze b2 remote and --files-from option seems to ignore --fast-list option.
body:
<!--

Welcome :-) We understand you are having a problem with rclone; we want to help you with that!

If you've just got a question or aren't sure if you've found a bug then please use the rclone forum:

    https://forum.rclone.org/

instead of filing an issue for a quick response.

If you think you might have found a bug, please can you try to replicate it with the latest beta?

    https://beta.rclone.org/
    
If you can still replicate it with the latest beta, then please fill in the info below which makes our lives much easier.  A log with -vv will make our day :-)

Thank you

The Rclone Developers

-->

#### What is the problem you are having with rclone?
I'm trying to sync a lot of small files (~1,200,00 files with just ~45GB in total size) from my local machine to backblaze b2. Since I know exactly what files have changed I have a text file with all the changed filenames and am using the `--files-from` to just sync those files and speed up the process a lot. Since I also want to minimize b2 api calls I also specify `--fast-list` that should reduce api calls to backblaze (according to rclone documentation) and that worked untill I tried to combine it with `--fast-list` not it seems very slow and used up way more api calls then before, right up to my daily cap in fact.

#### What is your rclone version (output from `rclone version`)
rclone v1.46
- os/arch: linux/amd64
- go version: go1.11.5


#### Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit)
Ubuntu bash in WSL Windows 10 64bit


####  Which cloud storage system are you using? (eg Google Drive)
Backblaze b2


#### The command you were trying to run (eg `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
`rclone --fast-list --files-from ./mapChanges.txt --b2-hard-delete --transfers 32 sync /mnt/e/servermap_optimizedImages b2:usbCraft/map/ -P`

#### A log from the command with the `-vv` flag (eg output from `rclone -vv copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
Unfortunatly I don't have this right now and also could not test it with the latest beta yet since I've used up my Daily Class C transactions on backblaze and don't want to increase them today, I will however run the same command with debug output and in the latest beta tomorrow after the cap resets.
